# Protocol coverage

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_protocol from the protocol specification and the sources in lib/.
     Do not edit: run `dune build @gen --auto-promote`. -->

What version 1.65.0 of Playwright's protocol offers, and what of it this client uses. A command
counts as used when a module in `lib/` calls its function in `Protocol`; whether and how it
reaches the public interface is a matter of that module. `dune runtest` fails when this file
is not what the generator would write, so that an update of the protocol shows here what it
added. See [protocol.md](protocol.md).

The client sends 188 of the 283 commands of the 27 interfaces that it knows.

reads `| Event _ -> ()` there.
